title: Formal Adverbs: もはや, かつて, ことごとく, いまだに, てっきり, 案の定, あえて
description: No longer, once (in the past), every single one, still, I was sure (but wrong), just as feared, and dare to.

points.title: もはや: no longer, by now
points.summary: もはや = it's already too late / things have changed (+ ない or a new state).
examples: それはもはや{常識|じょうしき}だ。

points.title: かつて: once, formerly
points.summary: かつて = at one time in the past. かつてない = unprecedented.
points.body: - ここは**かつて**城があった場所だ.
examples: かつてない{規模|きぼ}の{災害|さいがい}だ。
It's a disaster on an unprecedented scale.

points.title: ことごとく: every single one
points.summary: ことごとく = all, without exception (often failure / rejection).
points.body: - 予想は**ことごとく**外れた.
examples: {提案|ていあん}はことごとく{却下|きゃっか}された。

points.title: いまだに: still (even now)
points.summary: いまだに = still, even after all this time (often with surprise or regret).
points.body: - あの日のことは**いまだに**忘れられない.
examples: {彼|かれ}はいまだに{独身|どくしん}だ。

points.title: てっきり: I was sure (but wrong)
points.summary: てっきり + と思った = I took it for granted — and was mistaken.
points.body: - **てっきり**休みだと思っていたのに、店は開いていた.
examples: てっきり{彼|かれ}が{犯人|はんにん}だと{思|おも}った。
I was sure he was the culprit.

points.title: 案の定: just as feared
points.summary: 案の定 (あんのじょう) = sure enough, just as expected (usually bad).
points.body: - 傘を持たずに出たら、**案の定**雨に降られた.
examples: {心配|しんぱい}していたが、{案|あん}の{定|じょう}{失敗|しっぱい}した。
I'd been worried, and sure enough it failed.

points.title: あえて: dare to, deliberately
points.summary: あえて = deliberately do something difficult / unwelcome.
points.body: - 反対されるのはわかっていたが、**あえて**意見を言った.
examples: あえて{言|い}わせてもらえば、この{計画|けいかく}は{無理|むり}だ。
If I may be so bold: this plan won't work.

questions.prompt: ここまで{来|き}たら、（　）{後戻|あともど}りはできない。
notes: いまだに = 'still' — doesn't fit 'no going back now'.
questions.translation: Now that we've come this far, there's no turning back.

questions.prompt: What does 「それはもはや{常識|じょうしき}だ。」 mean?
options: That used to be common knowledge.
That will never be common knowledge.

questions.prompt: ここは（　）{大|おお}きな{城|しろ}があった{場所|ばしょ}だ。
questions.translation: There was once a great castle here.

questions.prompt: What does 「かつてない{規模|きぼ}の{災害|さいがい}」 mean?
options: a disaster on an unprecedented scale
a disaster that no longer exists

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}の{予想|よそう}は（　）{外|はず}れた。
questions.translation: Every one of his predictions was wrong.

questions.prompt: {私|わたし}の{提案|ていあん}は（　）{却下|きゃっか}された。
questions.translation: Every single one of my proposals was rejected.

questions.prompt: あの{日|ひ}のことは（　）{忘|わす}れられない。
notes: もはや忘れられない isn't natural.
questions.translation: I still can't forget that day.

questions.prompt: What does 「{彼|かれ}はいまだに{独身|どくしん}だ。」 mean?
options: He'll be single from now on.

questions.prompt: （　）{休|やす}みだと{思|おも}っていたのに、{店|みせ}は{開|あ}いていた。
questions.explanation: I was sure (but wrong): **てっきり**.
notes: すっかり = 'completely' — but てっきり is the 'wrongly sure' word.
案の定 = 'just as expected' — but the expectation was wrong.
questions.translation: I was sure it was closed, but the shop was open.

questions.prompt: What does 「てっきり{彼|かれ}が{犯人|はんにん}だと{思|おも}った。」 mean?
options: I knew all along he was the culprit.
I suspected he might be the culprit.
He confessed he was the culprit.
I was sure he was the culprit (but he wasn't).
notes: てっきり implies being wrong.
てっきり is certainty, not doubt.

questions.prompt: {傘|かさ}を{持|も}たずに{出|で}たら、（　）{雨|あめ}に{降|ふ}られた。
notes: てっきり needs と思う.
questions.translation: I went out without an umbrella, and sure enough I got rained on.

questions.prompt: What does 「{心配|しんぱい}していたが、{案|あん}の{定|じょう}{失敗|しっぱい}した。」 mean?
options: I'd been worried, and sure enough it failed.
I was worried, but it worked.
I worried, so I made a plan.

questions.prompt: {反対|はんたい}されるのはわかっていたが、（　）{意見|いけん}を{言|い}った。
questions.translation: I knew I'd be opposed, but I deliberately spoke my mind.

questions.prompt: What does 「あえて{言|い}わせてもらえば、この{計画|けいかく}は{無理|むり}だ。」 mean?
options: I won't say it, but the plan won't work.
I was forced to say this plan won't work.
If I may be so bold: this plan won't work.
Let me say again that the plan won't work.
